extracted.name: Almond flour pancakes
extracted.description: Serve these gluten-free pancakes with berries and syrup, if you like. If you can't get hold of almond flour, blitz ground almonds until fine
instruction_lines: Whisk together the eggs, almond milk and maple syrup, then tip in the almond flour, baking powder, ¼ tsp salt and the vanilla, and stir together.

Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium-low heat. Add a couple of heaped tablespoons of the batter and cook until the edges are set, around 2-3 mins. Flip and cook for a further 2 mins until golden. Repeat with the remaining batter. Serve the pancakes in small stacks, scattered with the blueberries.
